name: gastown-deploy
description: Federation deployment toolkit for Gastown rig → VPS via Tailscale SSH

scripts.restart:backend: node shell.js --cmd 'cd /docker/federation-game && docker compose restart backend'
scripts.restart:worker: node shell.js --cmd 'cd /docker/federation-game && docker compose build worker && docker compose up -d worker'
scripts.restart:frontend: node shell.js --cmd 'cd /docker/federation-game && docker compose restart frontend'
scripts.logs:backend: node shell.js --cmd 'cd /docker/federation-game && docker compose logs --tail=30 backend'
scripts.logs:worker: node shell.js --cmd 'cd /docker/federation-game && docker compose logs --tail=30 worker'
